question: Which animal has a very long trunk? 🐘
explanation: Awesome! An elephant uses its long trunk to eat food and drink water! 🐘
hint: It is a very big, grey animal.

question: Where do fish live? 🐟
explanation: Great job! Fish live, swim, and breathe underwater! 🐟
hint: They swim in rivers and oceans.

question: What do birds use to fly in the sky? 🦅
explanation: Super! Birds flap their beautiful wings to fly high up in the sky! 🦅
hint: They flap these in the air.

question: Which animal loves to swing on trees? 🐒
explanation: Fantastic! Monkeys use their long arms and tails to swing from branch to branch! 🐒
hint: This animal loves eating bananas.

question: What sound does a dog make? 🐕
explanation: Awesome! Dogs bark and say bow-wow when they talk to us! 🐕
hint: This animal guards our house.

question: What do we call very tall and big plants? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Very tall and strong plants with a thick trunk are called trees! 🌳
hint: Apples and mangoes grow on them.

question: Which animal hops and has long ears? 🐇
explanation: Super! Rabbits have long ears and they love to hop around! 🐇
hint: It loves to eat carrots.

question: What is the green part of a plant called? 🍃
explanation: Fantastic! Leaves are the green parts that make food for the plant! 🍃
hint: They fall from trees in autumn.

question: Which animal gives us sweet milk to drink? 🐄
explanation: Awesome! Cows eat green grass and give us healthy milk! 🐄
hint: It says moo-moo.

question: How can we take good care of a pet dog? 🐶
explanation: Great job! We must give food, water, and lots of love to our pets! 🐶
hint: Think about what makes you happy when you are hungry.

question: What does a cat say? 🐈
explanation: Super! A cute cat says meow when it wants milk or cuddles! 🐈
hint: This animal loves to catch mice.

question: Which part of a bird is used to eat food? 🐦
explanation: Fantastic! Birds use their hard beaks to pick up seeds and worms! 🐦
hint: It is like a mouth for a bird.

question: Which insect has beautiful, colorful wings? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! Butterflies fly from flower to flower with their beautiful wings! 🦋
hint: It starts as a little caterpillar.

question: Which animal has a hard shell on its back? 🐢
explanation: Great job! A turtle hides inside its hard shell to stay safe! 🐢
hint: It walks very slowly.

question: Where does a bird make its home? 🪹
explanation: Super! Birds build cozy nests in trees to keep their eggs safe! 🪹
hint: It is made of twigs and dry grass.

question: Which animal can live on land AND in water? 🐸
explanation: Fantastic! Frogs can hop on the green grass and swim in the pond! 🐸
hint: It says croak-croak.

question: What is the most colorful and pretty part of a plant? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! Flowers are colorful and smell very sweet! 🌸
hint: Butterflies love to sit on this.

question: Which animal is called the King of the Jungle? 🦁
explanation: Great job! The brave lion is known as the King of the Jungle! 🦁
hint: It has a big mane and roars loudly.

question: What do plants need to grow big and strong? 💧
explanation: Super! Plants drink water and use sunlight to grow big and healthy! 🌱
hint: Think about what rain gives to plants.

question: Which animal has a very long neck? 🦒
explanation: Fantastic! A giraffe uses its long neck to eat leaves from very tall trees! 🦒
hint: It is yellow with brown spots.

question: What sound does a duck make? 🦆
explanation: Awesome! Ducks swim in the pond and say quack-quack! 🦆
hint: It has a yellow beak and webbed feet.

question: Which animal has black and white stripes? 🦓
explanation: Great job! A zebra looks like a horse but has lovely black and white stripes! 🦓
hint: It looks like a horse with stripes.

question: Which bird dances beautifully when it rains? 🦚
explanation: Super! Peacocks open their colorful tail feathers and dance in the rain! 🦚
hint: It is the national bird of India.

question: Which tiny insect makes sweet honey? 🍯
explanation: Fantastic! Honey bees visit flowers and make yummy, sweet honey for us! 🐝
hint: It goes buzz-buzz.

question: How does a snake move on the ground? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! Snakes do not have legs, so they slither and slide on the ground! 🐍
hint: It glides like a rope.

question: Which animal guards our house at night? 🐕
explanation: Great job! Dogs are very smart and protect our homes from strangers! 🐕
hint: It wags its tail when happy.

question: Where does a spider live? 🕸️
explanation: Super! Spiders spin sticky webs to live in and catch their food! 🕸️
hint: It has 8 legs and spins silk.

question: Which animal has big, floppy ears like fans? 🐘
explanation: Fantastic! Elephants use their big ears to keep themselves cool! 🐘
hint: It is the largest animal on land.

question: What is a baby dog called? 🐶
explanation: Awesome! A little baby dog is called a playful puppy! 🐶
hint: It starts with the letter P.

question: What does a frog love to do? 🐸
explanation: Great job! Frogs have strong back legs that help them jump very far! 🐸
hint: It leaps from a lily pad.

question: How can we help birds in summer? 🐦
explanation: Super! Birds get thirsty, so keeping a bowl of water helps them stay cool! 🐦
hint: Think about what you drink when it is hot.

question: Which animal is very tall and runs fast? 🐎
explanation: Fantastic! Horses are strong and can gallop very fast! 🐎
hint: People love to ride on its back.

question: What grows under the ground to hold a plant? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! Roots stay hidden in the soil and drink water for the plant! 🌱
hint: It is at the very bottom of the plant.

question: Which animal wakes us up in the morning? 🐓
explanation: Great job! The rooster says cock-a-doodle-doo when the sun comes up! 🐓
hint: It is a bird that lives on a farm.

question: Which bird stays awake at night? 🦉
explanation: Super! Owls sleep in the day and use their big eyes to see at night! 🦉
hint: It goes hoot-hoot in the dark.

question: What is a baby cat called? 🐱
explanation: Fantastic! A tiny, soft baby cat is called a kitten! 🐱
hint: It loves to play with yarn.

question: Which animal gives us warm wool? 🐑
explanation: Awesome! We make warm sweaters from the soft wool of a sheep! 🐑
hint: It says baa-baa.

question: What sound does a pig make? 🐖
explanation: Great job! A cute little pig says oink-oink and loves to play in the mud! 🐖
hint: It has a curly pink tail.

question: Which plant part do we eat like an apple? 🍎
explanation: Super! Fruits are the sweet and yummy parts of a tree that we can eat! 🍎
hint: Mangoes and bananas are also this.

question: What do we call the soft, green carpet on the ground? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! Grass is the small green plant we love to run and play on! 🌿
hint: Cows love to eat this.

question: Which animal carries its house on its back? 🐌
explanation: Awesome! A snail has a spiral shell on its back and moves very slowly! 🐌
hint: It is very small and loves rainy days.

question: What should we do if our pet is sick? 🩺
explanation: Great job! A special animal doctor (a vet) helps our pets feel better! 🩺
hint: Just like us, animals need medicine.

question: Which animal is yellow with black spots? 🐆
explanation: Super! A leopard is a big cat with beautiful spots that can run fast! 🐆
hint: It looks a little like a tiger but has spots, not stripes.

question: Which animal is the fastest runner? 🐆
explanation: Fantastic! The cheetah is the fastest animal on land! 🐆
hint: It is a big cat with spots.

question: What does a green parrot like to eat? 🦜
explanation: Awesome! Parrots love eating green chilies, guavas, and sweet fruits! 🦜
hint: It has a red curved beak.

question: Where does a pet dog usually sleep? 🏠
explanation: Great job! A special little house made for a dog is called a kennel! 🏠
hint: It is like a small wooden house.

question: What does a tiny mouse say? 🐁
explanation: Super! Mice make a tiny, high squeak-squeak sound! 🐁
hint: It loves eating cheese.

question: Which bug glows in the dark at night? 🪲
explanation: Fantastic! Fireflies have a special light in their bodies that glows at night! 🌟
hint: It looks like a tiny flying star.

question: What is the hard, wooden part of a tree called? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! The thick, brown, wooden part standing up tall is the tree trunk! 🪵
hint: Branches grow from it.

question: How should we treat all plants and animals? ❤️
explanation: Great job! Plants and animals are our friends, and we must always love them! ❤️
hint: It makes everyone happy and safe.
